summary: Iteration 28 (bug fix verification): verified badge in comments on WEB reels, WEB videos, and MOBILE reels. 5/5 backend pytest cases pass. WEB ReelWatch drawer renders 19 verified badges for existing rows; a fresh founder comment appears immediately with the badge (badge count 19 -> 20 without reload). WEB VideoWatch shows the badge next to founder comments (data-testid=video-comment-verified-<id>). MOBILE CommentSheet still shows the checkmark-circle next to every semidiepie row. Regression confirmed: a fresh test_iter28_* non-verified user's comment renders WITHOUT any badge on both web and mobile, and the backend GET /api/posts/{id}/comments returns is_verified=false for that row. Founder password preserved (Semi123!).
critical_code_review_comments: WEB /app/frontend/src/pages/VideoWatch.jsx line ~83: POST /api/videos/{id}/comments returns ONLY {id, text} (see /app/backend/routes/videos.py line 304). The web code does setComments((rows) => [c, ...rows]) with that stub object, so the just-posted video comment renders WITHOUT a display_name, avatar or verified badge until a page reload. Reels don't have this bug because /api/posts/{id}/comments POST returns the full flat comment. Recommend the backend return the full serialized comment (with author.is_verified) OR the frontend refetch /api/videos/{id}/comments after a successful POST.

SCHEMA INCONSISTENCY: /api/posts/{id}/comments returns FLAT fields (is_verified, username, display_name, avatar_url) while /api/videos/{id}/comments returns NESTED author.is_verified. Both surfaces currently handle both shapes with `c.is_verified || c.author?.is_verified`, but this dual-shape contract is easy to break. Consider unifying comment serialization across the two collections (db.comments vs db.video_comments).

MOBILE /app/mobile/src/components/CommentSheet.tsx line 112: the verified badge has NO testID (unlike its web sibling data-testid=reel-comment-verified-<id>). Adding testID={`comment-verified-${item.id}`} would allow automated regression to assert badge presence per-row instead of relying on visual diff.

NOTE: /app/frontend/src/pages/ReelWatch.jsx line 230 still has the dead nested fallback c.author?.avatar_url / c.author?.display_name / c.author?.is_verified — the API only returns flat fields. Cleaning up avoids future confusion. Same nit as flagged in iteration 27.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The verified-badge fix is stable across web and mobile. New selectors introduced this iteration: WEB data-testid=reel-comment-verified-<id> (ReelWatch) and data-testid=video-comment-verified-<id> (VideoWatch). MOBILE badge is still un-tagged (Ionicons name=checkmark-circle inside CommentSheet). Reel comments use the FLAT is_verified shape from /api/posts/{id}/comments (with backfill for old rows). Video comments use NESTED author.is_verified from /api/videos/{id}/comments and the POST endpoint returns only {id,text}—so newly-posted video comments do NOT render a badge/avatar until reload. Not fixed in this iteration since only reel-side badge was in scope, but flagged in action items/critical_code_review_comments.
rca of the issue: Original bug: web reel comment drawer rendered display_name only, with no BadgeCheck icon, so verified users (including founder) appeared indistinguishable from anyone else. Backend already returned is_verified as a flat field on each comment (with a backfill query for legacy rows), but the ReelWatch (and VideoWatch) comment rows never read it. Fix: both pages now render <BadgeCheck /> when (c.is_verified || c.author?.is_verified) is truthy, with a stable data-testid per row. Verified in-flight: posting a new founder comment increments the badge count client-side without a reload (the POST response echoes the flat is_verified=true for reels). Regression on the non-verified path confirmed by registering a throwaway test_iter28_* user and posting on the same reel — the row renders without a badge on both surfaces and the API returns is_verified=false for that row.
